scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build --workspace functions
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace functions && node --test tests/domain.test.mjs tests/rewards.test.mjs tests/adventure.test.mjs
scripts.test:emulators: npm run prepare:assets && npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-spell-bee --only auth,firestore,functions,storage 'npm run test:integration'
scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('Deployment disabled pending a reviewed release.');process.exit(1)"
scripts.format: prettier --write src functions/src scripts tests *.json *.ts README.md docs
scripts.build:production: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/build-production.mjs && npm run build --workspace functions
